title: TIME Studios and Piers Morgan's Uncensored Announce New Interview Series
summary:
The New Premium Video Podcast Featuring Long-Form Profile Conversations Debuts Summer 2026 Across TIME and Uncensored Platforms

TIME Studios, the Emmy Award-winning television, film and branded content studio, and Uncensored, Piers Morgan's independent digital media company, today announced a partnership to co-produce and distribute a new ongoing long-form interview series.

Hosted by Morgan and set to debut in summer 2026, the series will feature in-depth conversations with influential figures across sports, politics, global affairs, business, and culture. With Morgan’s signature candor and incisive interviewing style, these profiles will go beyond the headlines, combining TIME’s global authority with Morgan’s unfiltered perspective.

The series will be built on TIME's unparalleled access to the world's most influential people that has defined its trusted journalism for more than a century, exemplified by recent landmark interviews with figures including 2023 TIME Person of the Year Taylor Swift, President Donald Trump, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, F1 champion Lewis Hamilton, and Russian opposition leader Yulia Navalnaya, among many others. 

“TIME is one of the world’s most respected journalistic brands, and I’m delighted to be joining forces with them for this exciting new show,” said Morgan. “Having unfiltered conversations with some of the world’s most interesting, successful, and insightful people has always been one of my great passions and this is a great next step in the evolution of the rapidly expanding Uncensored brand.”

"Piers Morgan is one of the most compelling interviewers in the world and we are excited to combine his talent and established audience with TIME’s century-long legacy of credibility and global access to deliver quality interviews viewers can’t find anywhere else,” said Ben Bitonti, President of TIME Studios. “As we continue to expand TIME Studios, we are focused on collaborating with world-class creators and established voices like Piers to produce original content that drives global relevance."

The show will be distributed across TIME and Uncensored’s YouTube and social channels, as well as all major audio platforms. Combined, the two media outlets reach over 65 million digital followers and subscribers and this new partnership offers the TIME and Uncensored audiences a front-row seat to headline-making conversations. Over the past year, Morgan has interviewed figures like President Volodymyr Zelensky, Cristiano Ronaldo, Novak Djokovic and Canelo Alvarez. Through this new collaboration with TIME, he will continue to deliver substantive, unfiltered discussions that delve into stories and themes that drive global conversation.

This new venture reinforces TIME Studios' proven strength in unscripted formats, demonstrated by its critically acclaimed slate, which includes the Emmy-winning Frida, The Lionheart, Big Vape: The Rise and Fall of Juul, Megan Thee Stallion: In Her Words, Dirty Pop: The Boy Band Scam, the immersive documentary D-Day: The Camera Soldier for Apple Vision Pro, and the forthcoming branded docuseries The Culture of Currency with Wyclef Jean, among others.

### 

ABOUT TIME STUDIOS

From one of the most globally iconic brands, TIME Studios is an Emmy Award-winning television and film studio as well as an award-winning immersive and branded content studio, focused on the development, production, and distribution of premium unscripted and scripted storytelling that moves the world. With technical innovation and a brand-defining visual language that dates back 102 years, TIME Studios aims to impact communities and the world at large with ideas that forge true progress. Combining the industry's leading creators with TIME, one of the most trusted brands that reaches an audience of over 120 million people globally, TIME Studios is uniquely positioned to bring massive audiences to the world's most impactful stories.

ABOUT UNCENSORED

Uncensored is a rapidly growing media network, which produces and distributes smart, compelling, high-engagement content across platforms. Its flagship daily show, Piers Morgan Uncensored, is the marquee global arena for spirited debate and conversation with world leaders, newsmakers, cultural figures, and subject matter experts. On YouTube alone, Piers Morgan Uncensored amassed over 1 billion views and 4 million subscribers in under four years and currently averages 1 million views per day on a monthly basis. Other shows include the recently launched History Uncensored with Bianca Nobilo and the just-announced The Royals Uncensored, to be hosted by award-winning journalists Katie Nicholl and Jo Elvin, which will launch on April 30. Uncensored is led by CEO Rashida Jones, Executive Editor Alexander Campbell, and Piers Morgan, company founder and host of Piers Morgan Uncensored.

The gas industry is a very profitable industry and pays income tax. And every company in Australia, frankly, should pay income tax on its profits and should pay the proper rate. But the gas companies are different because they also sell an Australian resource which they extract, which we can’t get back once it is sold.

I think Australians rightly believe they should share more of that revenue.

We’re back here again and they should fix it.

We are lucky to be an energy exporter at a time where the world needs energy. We are a great partner in this. But it is a reasonable thing for Australians to get a fair return on that. And, at the moment, we just aren’t.
